findings: Raising sv_minimum_desired_chicken_count from 0 to 10 is sufficient to create a ten-chicken runtime population without any player death event.
Entity indices are not monotonically increasing and include recycled older slots; entindex must not be used as a simple birth-order clock.
The population manager is directly responsive to the minimum desired chicken count variable in this runtime context.
next_gate: Kill exactly one chicken and sample ent_find chicken immediately, then after 5s, 15s, and 30s without any player death or round restart.
